parent.delete-confirm-body: This removes all saved progress for this child. This cannot be undone.

privacy.contact-body: Open an issue on the project's GitHub repository: {{url}}
privacy.control-body: Export or delete any child's data any time, from Backup and from that child's Settings in the parent area.
privacy.data-body: A nickname, an avatar picture, and lesson progress for each child — stored only on this device, never sent anywhere.
privacy.intro: {{app}} keeps everything on this device. Here's exactly what that means.
privacy.network-body: The only network access is checking for app updates. Updates are static files delivered from GitHub Pages. "Send to other device" hands the file to whichever app or device the parent picks — the app itself still sends nothing.
privacy.no-accounts-body: No sign-up, no analytics, no ads, no third-party services. The app never phones home.
privacy.title: Privacy

bug-squash.goal: Find the wrong arrow in every program. How few mistakes can you make?
bug-squash.title: Bug Squash

fence-builder.goal: Build every fence with a Repeat. Stars are the fence posts! How few mistakes can you make?
fence-builder.title: Fence Builder

left-right-rescue.goal: Fox's left and right! Collect every star, then reach the flag. How few mistakes can you make?
left-right-rescue.title: Left-Right Rescue

loop-chunk.demo: Right, up, right, up, right, up. That is Repeat three times, right and up!
loop-chunk.story: Owl says: a Repeat can hold more than one tile. Fox does all of them, then does them all again. Look for the steps that come back again and again!
loop-chunk.title: Repeat a chunk

loop-debug.demo: Count the steps Fox needs. If the number on the Repeat is wrong, that is the bug!
loop-debug.story: Owl says: a loop can have bugs too. The number can be wrong, or one tile inside the loop. Watch Fox, find the wrong tile and fix it!
loop-debug.title: Loop bugs

loop-pattern.demo: Four arrows the same? One Repeat says it shorter. Repeat four times, right!
loop-pattern.story: Owl says: look for a pattern, the same steps again and again. A Repeat block does them again for you. Put an arrow inside it, then tap the number to say how many times!
loop-pattern.title: See the pattern

loop-repeat.demo: Fox must cross five squares to the right. So the Repeat says five times, right!
loop-repeat.story: Owl says: Repeat does the same step again and again. Pick the step, then tap the number. Count the squares Fox must cross to know the number!
loop-repeat.title: Repeat N

seq-arrows.demo: Read the arrows from left to right: right, right, down. One arrow is one step.
seq-arrows.story: Owl says: Fox follows arrows, one arrow for each step. Read them from left to right. Up goes towards the top of the screen!
seq-arrows.title: Walk the path

seq-collect.demo: Fox steps on the star to pick it up. Then Fox goes to the flag.
seq-collect.story: Owl says: rocks block Fox's way, so plan a path around them. Fox picks up a star by stepping on it. Collect every star, then reach the flag!
seq-collect.title: Collect the stars

seq-debug.demo: A bug is one wrong step. Find it, fix it, and the program works!
seq-debug.story: Owl says: a bug is one wrong step in a program. Watch Fox, find the wrong step and fix it. Even Fox makes bugs, and that is okay!
seq-debug.title: Bug hunt

seq-order.demo: Look: first the socks, then the shoes. Shoes first would be silly!
seq-order.story: Owl says: a program is a list of steps. The steps must be in the right order. Fox puts on socks first, then shoes!
seq-order.title: Steps in order

turn-build.demo: Fox faces up. Forward, forward, turn right, forward. Up, up, then right!
turn-build.story: Owl says: now Fox walks like you do. Forward goes the way Fox faces. Turn left or turn right to face a new way!
turn-build.title: Forward and turn

turn-debug.demo: Turn left instead of turn right? Fox goes the wrong way. Swap the tile and Fox is fine!
turn-debug.story: Owl says: left and right can get mixed up! Watch Fox, find the tile that sends Fox the wrong way and fix it. A turn where Fox should walk is a bug too.
turn-debug.title: Mirror bugs

turn-facing.demo: Fox faces up. Turn right, and Fox faces right. Turn right again, and Fox faces down.
turn-facing.story: Owl says: a turn spins Fox around on the spot. Fox keeps facing that way until the next turn. Left and right are Fox's own left and right — look where Fox is facing!
turn-facing.title: Which way am I facing?

turn-jump.demo: Jump goes two squares. Fox flies over the rock and does not touch it!
turn-jump.story: Owl says: a wall of rocks blocks the way! Jump goes two squares in one move, over one rock. Fox lands on the second square.
turn-jump.title: Jump the gap

turn-loop.demo: Forward, turn right, again and again. Fox draws a square!
turn-loop.story: Owl says: Repeat works with turns too! Repeat forward and turn right, and Fox walks round in a square. Count the sides, and that is the number!
turn-loop.title: Turns in loops
